typography.pairing_rules: Use Outfit for all headings and large impact numbers. Use DM Sans for all body copy, inputs, and UI elements. Use JetBrains Mono for AI-generated code snippets or 'thinking' states.

accent.description: Cyber Cyan - Digital accents, high contrast

gradients.text_gradient: bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-br from-white via-white to-white/50

colors.theme_strategy: Dark mode is the primary 'Night Life' aesthetic. Light mode should feel clean and editorial.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use a subtle noise texture overlay on the dark background to prevent banding and add organic feel.

layout_strategy.grid_system: Use the 'Bento Grid' (Mode A) for the Landing Page features. Use 'High Density' (Mode B) for the Dashboard stats.
layout_strategy.spacing: Generous spacing. Section padding: py-24 or py-32. Component padding: p-6 or p-8.

motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-lg hover:shadow-primary/25 rounded-full px-8 py-6 font-bold tracking-wide transition-all hover:scale-105 active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary/10 text-secondary hover:bg-secondary/20 border border-secondary/20 rounded-full px-6 py-4 font-medium backdrop-blur-sm
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent/10 hover:text-accent text-muted-foreground rounded-lg px-4 py-2

cards.feature: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl bg-card border border-border/50 p-8 hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors
cards.stats: bg-card/50 backdrop-blur-sm border border-border/30 rounded-2xl p-6

inputs.base: bg-background/50 border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-xl h-12 px-4 transition-all

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL DEPENDENCIES: `npm install framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge`

2. SETUP TAILWIND: Update `tailwind.config.js` to include the new colors (Electric Magenta, Deep Violet) and fonts (Outfit, DM Sans). Add the fonts to `index.css` via @import or Google Fonts link in public/index.html.
3. IMPLEMENT THEME TOGGLE: Ensure the dark mode is the DEFAULT. Use local storage to persist preference.
4. CREATE LAYOUTS: Build the Landing Page using the Bento Grid (Mode A). Build the Dashboard using the High Density Grid (Mode B).
5. USE SHADCN: Use the existing Shadcn components in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui` but OVERRIDE their default styles to match the 'Rizz' aesthetic (more rounded, glowing borders).
6. AI FEATURES: Mock the AI responses for now, but build the UI to handle 'Typing...' states and markdown rendering for the pickup lines.
7. IMAGE HANDLING: Use the provided Pexels URLs. Ensure they have `object-cover` and proper aspect ratios.
8. ANIMATION: Apply `framer-motion` to all page transitions and major component entrances. Use 'staggerChildren' for lists.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖 etc.
